prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene unfolds within a humid botanical greenhouse filled with lush ferns and towering palms. On the left, an elderly woman in a wide-brimmed straw hat stands beside a rustic wooden potting bench, her posture upright and attentive as she observes the greenery. Next to her, a young boy in blue overalls points excitedly toward a hanging orchid, his finger extended in clear direction. In the center, a gardener wearing muddy green coveralls kneels on the tiled floor, carefully repotting a small succulent into a terracotta container. A sleek black cat sits calmly on the edge of the central worktable, watching the activity with narrowed eyes. To the right, a man in a red scarf leans against a glass pane, holding a watering can while looking at the kneeling gardener. Beside him, a large potted monstera plant displays broad, fenestrated leaves that catch the diffused light. The elderly woman is handing a trowel to the young boy, facilitating their shared gardening task. Meanwhile, the man in the red scarf is looking at the gardener, creating a subtle line of sight across the room. There is no digital technology or modern electronic devices visible in this organic setting. The atmosphere is thick with humidity, condensation clinging to the high arched windows above. The composition balances the human figures with the overwhelming presence of nature, ensuring each element remains distinct yet harmoniously integrated into the single frame.
